description: Update a Cloud DB Serverless cluster (PATCH /mysql/v1/clusters/{clusterName}, merge-patch → 202 Operation). Only the given fields change: unit (min+max), multiZone, autoScale, backupConfig (retentionDays required when given). Setting scaleOut.enabled=false resets the replica range. Use dryRun=true to preview.

thresholdConnection.description: Scale-out trigger by connections (500-30,000; mutually exclusive with thresholdCpu)

thresholdCpu.description: Scale-out trigger by CPU % (30-99; mutually exclusive with thresholdConnection)

enabled.description: Vertical scaling between unit.min and unit.max (default false = pinned to unit.max)

backupAuto.description: true (default) = service-chosen time (backupTime ignored); false = use backupTime

backupTime.description: Backup time HH:MM in UTC (required when backupAuto=false)

clusterName.description: Cluster name (3-30 chars, lowercase letters/digits/'-', no leading or trailing '-'; immutable after creation)

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without changing

multiZone.description: Enable/disable backup-zone replicas (enabling provisions and syncs replicas)

max.description: Maximum unit (≥1, multiple of 0.5, ≥ min). Without autoScale.scaleUp the cluster is pinned to max

name: ncloud_serverless_update_cluster
